create_TimedeltaIndex: create a TimedeltaIndex from an array-like of timedelta-like values with optional frequency and name
build_timedelta_range: build a fixed-frequency TimedeltaIndex with specified start, end, periods, and frequency
test_TimedeltaIndex_negate: test negating a TimedeltaIndex while preserving or negating its frequency attribute
test_TimedeltaIndex_arithmetic: test arithmetic operations on a TimedeltaIndex and compute resulting frequency for multiply and divide
test_TimedeltaIndex_indexing: test getting the integer location of a key in a TimedeltaIndex via get_loc
